verdict.rationale: A CRM could plausibly ship a built-in AI assistant that connects to external MCP servers, so this axis applies. The evidence pack documents only a REST API, Zapier, and standard integrations. Nothing shows Capsule itself acting as an MCP client or letting users register MCP servers for it to use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
